site.name: Maqati3
site.tagline: The words of the scholars, linked to the second they were said.

attribution.probably: Attribution not confirmed from a primary source

entry.translationPending: No reviewed translation yet. The Arabic original is below.

upload.title: Upload recordings
upload.intro: Choose up to 20 videos or audio files at once. Each one is checked straight away: if it is already in the archive you will see it here, and you decide.
upload.badLink: This link is incomplete. Please ask the admin for the upload link again.
upload.tooMany: Only {max} files per batch. {count} were left out — send this batch first, then add them.

status.checking: Checking whether it is already in the archive…
status.rejected: Exactly this file is already in the archive. It was not uploaded again.
status.rejectedPending: Exactly this file was already uploaded — by another brother, or earlier in this batch. It was not uploaded again.
status.candidates: Possibly already in the archive — please check

error.no_readable_audio: This file has no sound that could be read. Is it a photo or a screen recording?
error.upload_key_required: The upload link is not valid any more. Please ask the admin for the current link.
error.too_many_attempts: Too many tries with a wrong upload link from this connection. Please wait about ten minutes and try again, and ask the admin whether your link is still the current one.

candidate.pending: A recording like this was already uploaded — by another brother, or earlier in this batch. It has not been reviewed yet.
candidate.withheld: A recording like this is already in the archive.

upload.send: Send {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}

blocked.busy: Wait until every file is checked.
blocked.undecided: Decide for every file marked “please check”.
blocked.empty: There is nothing new to send.
blocked.name: Enter your name first.

upload.done: Jazākallāhu khayran. {sent, plural, one {# file was} other {# files were}} sent and will be reviewed.
upload.leaveWarning: Some files have not been sent yet.
upload.yourNameHint: So we know who sent these files.

admin.title: Admin
admin.intro: Uploads waiting for a decision. Watch one, and if it is worth the review time, choose the scholar and register it.
admin.signedOutHint: Only admins who have been added can get in.

login.denied: That Google address has not been added as an admin. Ask for it to be added.
login.failed: The sign-in did not work. Please try again.

admin.notConfigured: Sign-in is not set up on this server yet.

waiting.title: Waiting for a decision ({count})
waiting.empty: Nothing is waiting. New uploads appear here.

admin.keptDespite: Kept although it matched something. Please listen to both:

scholar.label: Scholar
scholar.unclear: If you cannot tell who it is, just leave the video here.

admin.registerHint: Creates the entry. Its attribution stays “not sure” until someone sets it.
admin.transcribeHint: Sends the recording to the transcription service. The draft appears here for review in a few minutes.
admin.translateHint: Drafts English and German line by line. A person checks every line before anything is published.

drafts.waitingForArabic: Check the Arabic first. The drafts can be requested once someone has approved it.
drafts.queued: Draft translations requested — waiting for a worker.
drafts.failed: The draft translations did not work: {reason}
drafts.ready: English and German drafts ready for review.

transcript.queued: Transcription requested — waiting for a worker.

error.notWaiting: Someone has already dealt with this one. The list was reloaded.
error.unknownScholar: That scholar is not in the archive. Please choose again.
error.scholarExists: A scholar with that id already exists.
error.signedOut: You have been signed out. Please sign in again.
error.transcriptionNotConfigured: This server has no transcription service set up yet.
error.unknownEntry: That entry is not in the archive any more. The list was reloaded.
error.alreadyTranscribed: This recording already has a transcript, or someone is working on one.
error.alreadyQueued: A transcription for this recording is already on its way.
error.dailyLimitReached: Today's transcription budget is spent. It starts again tomorrow, or the admin can raise the limit.
error.translationNotConfigured: This server has no translation model set up yet.
error.nothingToTranslate: There is no Arabic transcript yet to translate.
error.alreadyTranslated: Both languages already have a draft, or someone is working on them.
error.arabicNotApproved: The drafts wait until a person has checked and approved the Arabic.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.unknownRow: That row is not there. Rows are never added or removed.
error.notInProgress: Take this language first. Only a language you are working on can be edited.
error.claimedByOther: Someone else is working on this language.
error.emptyText: A row cannot be left empty. Its second still belongs to it.
error.invalidTransition: That step is not possible from where this language stands. The page was reloaded.
error.reviewNotAvailable: The review editor is not available on this server.

log.failed: Could not load the action log.
log.subject: Subject

review.title: Review
review.approveConfirm: Approve this language? Once approved it can no longer be edited.
review.waitingForArabic: Check and approve the Arabic first. The translations can be taken afterwards.
review.readOnly: Take this language to edit it.
review.hint: One row per moment. Click a row to play from there. Rows are edited, never added or removed.
